dashboard.label: TA-memwatch Overview
dashboard.description: Collects early-warning memory signals from /proc/meminfo, /proc/vmstat and /proc/slabinfo: available-memory percentage, swap usage, cumulative swap-in/out counters, cumulative

panel.html: Commercial Use Commercial or production use of TA-memwatch requires a paid license. Evaluation, personal, and lab use is free. See the BentleyPC Commercial License for full terms. Buy License License & Terms

search.query: | mstats avg("memwatch.mem_available_pct") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("memwatch.swap_used_pct") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats sum("memwatch.oom_new") as value where index=metrics span=5m | stats sum(value) as value
| mstats avg("memwatch.slab_top_kb") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="memwatch:status" | dedup host | spath input=_raw output=x path=top_slabs{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | spath input=x | table host name kb
